category: hosted debrid bot (file-host link and magnet to download link)

free_tier.stated: Free account, valid for life ('Masa aktif selamanya'): 'maksimal 2 link per hari' through the bot, reset daily at 00:00 WIB.
free_tier.notes: the same 2-links-a-day Free allowance applies on the website ('Limit 2x Generate / Hari')

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-file cap is published for the Free plan on the pages read.
per_object_cap.notes: the premium FAQ says hundreds of gigabytes can be pulled if the source provider allows it; that is the paid Basic plan

retention.stated: unverified: how long a generated link lives is not stated on the pages read. The bot sends the final link when the server side finishes processing.

egress.terms: Files are fetched by the operator's servers and handed back as direct links; Free is 2 links a day, Basic is 'Unlimited Generate Links' under fair use with per-host daily limits.

interface_detail: A Telegram chat. The Telegram ID is entered on the website's account profile page first; then a hoster URL or a magnet link is sent to the bot. The bot does not accept .torrent files.
tooling: Any Telegram client and a debrid.web.id account. Nothing to install.
chaining: A hoster link or magnet in, a direct link out, from an Indonesian operator with local payment methods; the Free allowance is a link count, so it proves the route rather than carrying a workload.

limits.value: 2 links per day on a Free account, reset at 00:00 WIB
1 link per minute; more than 10 links in a short time triggers a 1-hour block, the second offence 24 hours, the third permanent

binding_note: Two links a day is the Free wall; the one-link-a-minute rate and the auto-block bind only inside it.

identity_cost.detail: The website's registration form asks for Username, Email address, an optional Referral Code and a Password; no card or phone field. The bot also needs a Telegram account (a phone-registered one by Telegram's own rule, not stated on these pages) whose ID is saved on the profile page.

reliability_note: Indonesian-language service; the supported-host list is dynamic and each host can cap daily size. Paid plans are priced in rupiah and paid by QRIS, GoPay, OVO, Dana or bank transfer 'tanpa kartu kredit'.
confidence_note: The Free allowance, the rate limit and the linking steps are stated on the cited debrid.web.id pages. No bot reply was observed.
